sentences: Before you register your business, you need a business number (BN) from the CRA.
If you expect to earn more than $30,000 in a year, you have to register for the GST/HST.
Keep your accounting records for six years after the end of the fiscal year they relate to.
You can apply for your SIN at a Service Canada office.

outputs.en: Keep your accounting records for six years after the end of the fiscal year they relate to.

outputs.en: You can apply for your SIN at a Service Canada office.
outputs.fr: Vous pouvez demander votre numéro d'assurance sociale (NAS) à un bureau de Services Canada.
